verification.scope: No cleaning window can be shown — the Montreal signage dataset contains no signs for this street.
verification.method: Géobase-double sides only. Signage coverage checked live: 0 records within ~400 m of 5950 Av Freud; 9 records in the wider box, all ~700 m north in Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce, none on Freud. Field photos Nov 17, 2026: the signs on BOTH sides are covered with black bags, so no rule can be read from either pole.
verification.still_owed: Both sides photographed Nov 17, 2026 — both signs bagged, no rule readable. Re-photograph when the bags come off; a rule only exists once the sign face is readable.
verification.coverage: Côte Saint-Luc is a separate municipality from the City of Montreal. Its street signage is not in the City of Montreal open-data signage set (stationnement sur rue — signalisation courante). Géobase double does cover the street sides (NOM_VILLE CSL, ID_TRC 1602798), so side identification works; cleaning windows do not.

season_reading: Season dates are INCLUSIVE both ends: a window applies on Apr 1 and on Dec 1 themselves when that date falls on a cleaning weekday. The countdown and the .ics export use this same reading.

street.verification_banner_html: No signage data for this street. Côte Saint-Luc is a separate municipality and its signs are not in the City of Montreal’s open-data set — the dataset has zero signs anywhere near Av Freud. No cleaning window can be shown for either side. Always check the sign where you park — photograph it if you can.
street.segment_note: Street sides come from Géobase double segment ID_TRC 1602798 (even 5950–6002, odd 6001–6025). The City of Montreal signage dataset has no signs on Av Freud (0 records within ~400 m; the 9 records in the wider box all stand ~700 m north, in Côte-des-Neiges–Notre-Dame-de-Grâce). Season Apr 1 – Dec 1 inclusive. Centreline: OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Times are America/Toronto.
street.centreline_note: Centreline ordered as fetched from OSM; cross-track sign is relative to that order (see ct_mapping_note).

method.fleche_pan: UNKNOWN — no codebook found (web search, dataset resources, empirical pairing analysis: codes 2/3 co-occur on the same poles in a pattern consistent with opposite directions, but which is which is unproven). Recorded verbatim, never used to disambiguate, never assumed to mean both directions.
notes: A sign is attributed to this street only if: 3-10 m from the OSM centreline, nearest point inside the street segment, and >=20 m along-track from either segment end. No nearest-sign fallback, ever.
A side's window is established only when >=2 poles carry the identical parsed window (same weekdays, hours, season) AND the CODE_RPA canonical text parses to that same window.
Parser is a whitelist grammar: \P prefix, one Hh/HhMM hour range, 1-7 full French weekday names, explicit D MONTH AU D MONTH season. Anything else is ambiguous.
EXCEPTE S3R is a flag (conservative default: restriction applies). Any other EXCEPTE/SAUF makes the sign ambiguous.
EN TOUT TEMPS is a permanent ban, never a window. \P = parking, \A = stopping.
Two different windows on one side = conflict: no countdown until resolved.
